smallest_patch_proposal.proposal: Preserve an unbased single-bit fill literal as a distinct context-sensitive IR value until its enclosing typed cast is known, or materialize it at the cast target width before emitting ordinary constant IR. Extend the Z3 builder only if a distinct fill token is chosen. Do not change the general cast zero/sign extension rule. Test '0/'1 and require X/Z constraint handling to retain its existing unknown-state policy.
